call_points.text: Business development target of ₹10,000-20,000 Cr GDV for FY27, after ₹18,000 Cr in each of the last two years.
K2 Kandivali is greenfield; launch targeted within 12-15 months as approvals and design proceed.
Rainforest booked close to ₹600 Cr in about five weeks of sales, at a premium to the micro market.
Five more launches planned this year; Mahalunge and Lakewoods are in final stages of approvals.
Eden Phase-2 and Luminaire completed in Q1 with PBT margins of about 26%.
Operating cash flow was ₹134 Cr in Q1, expected to pick up with Q2 collections and IC deals.
Management expects pricing growth of 4-6% versus 7-8% or 20% in past years, with investor demand fading.
IC business targets ₹1,500 Cr PAT over the next few years, translating to ₹150-200 Cr PAT and ₹200-250 Cr cash flow per year.
NCR re-entry deferred by at least a year; evaluating Kolkata, Chennai and Jaipur instead.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹669.62 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹89.32 Cr.
Mahindra Lifespace reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹669.62 Cr and PAT of ₹90.12 Cr, recommending a ₹3.50 dividend.
Mahindra Lifespace reported FY26 residential pre-sales of ₹3,405 Cr, GDV additions of ₹18,060 Cr and residential collections of ₹2,107 Cr.
Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited held an earnings call on 28 April 2026 at 5:00–6:05 p.m. (IST) discussing Q4 FY2026 results with analysts and institutional investors.
Crisil reaffirmed AA/Stable on ₹100 Cr proposed bank limits and withdrew the ₹300 Cr commercial paper rating.
Mahindra Lifespaces launched 'Mahindra BeaconHill', an ultra-premium residential tower in South Mumbai with ₹1,650 Cr GDV.
India Ratings assigned IND A1+ credit rating to ₹3,500 crore of commercial paper facilities.

Mahindra Lifespace filed a rectification on 26 May 2026, correcting its 14 May Ind-Ra disclosure: the ₹2,500 million commercial paper and ₹1,000 million proposed commercial paper (both IND A1+) had been mislabelled as crores instead of millions; ratings unchanged.

On 24 July 2026 Mahindra Lifespace's Q1FY27 call reported PAT of ₹86 Cr, up 67% YoY, on ₹962 Cr revenue from Eden Phase-2 and Luminaire completions, with residential pre-sales of ₹925 Cr and a FY27 pre-sales aspiration of ₹4,500-5,000 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹32.42 Cr (+84.6% YoY), net profit ₹16.34 Cr (-65.9% YoY).
Mahindra Lifespace Developers reported Q2FY27 residential pre-sales of ₹1,063 Cr and added ₹7,100 Cr of GDV in H1 FY27.
Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited held an earnings call on 22 October 2026, discussing Q2 & H1 FY2027 unaudited results with analysts and institutional investors.
